checkpoint_selection: final fixed epoch; no hyperparameter search
long_input_policy: fail whole run, never silently truncate or exclude rows
references: unmodified shipped native and ProtectAI DeBERTa ONNX on identical context JSON; raw max-document references reported separately
threshold_rule: validation only: maximum recall at FPR <= 1%; ties lower FPR then higher threshold
uncertainty: whole-family bootstrap seed 1, 1000 replicates; degenerate intervals omitted
purpose: context ablation and application references; not an equal-training-budget architecture ranking
counterfactuals: matched-task, identical-document authorization, and source-provenance pairs; no test-driven changes
